keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 1, Real Salt Lake 0. Ousseni Bouda (San Jose Earthquakes) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Benji Kikanovic (San Jose Earthquakes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 2, Real Salt Lake 0. Benji Kikanovic (San Jose Earthquakes) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jamar Ricketts following a fast break.
Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 2, Real Salt Lake 1. Juan Manuel Sanabria (Real Salt Lake) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Samuel Junqua with a cross.
First Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 2, Real Salt Lake 1.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Zach Booth replaces Dominik Marczuk.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Aiden Hezarkhani replaces Samuel Junqua.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Jack Jasinski replaces Benji Kikanovic.
Reid Roberts (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Niko Tsakiris (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Ronaldo Vieira replaces Ian Harkes.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Beau Leroux replaces Niko Tsakiris.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Eduard Löwen replaces Nick Fernandez.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Lukas Engel replaces Justen Glad.
Philip Quinton (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Noel Caliskan (Real Salt Lake).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Alexandros Katranis replaces Zach Booth because of an injury.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Ariath Piol replaces Stijn Spierings.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Luka Jovanovic replaces Preston Judd.
Alexandros Katranis (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 2, Real Salt Lake 1.
